Consent.title: Informed Consent & Medical Disclaimer
Consent.subtitle: Please review the following clinical, legal, and data processing terms prior to entering patient symptoms for geriatric emergency triage.
Consent.section1Desc: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (India, 2023), your identifiable health and demographic data is collected strictly for the purpose of emergency triage assessment, vital risk scoring, and authorized clinician review. Your data is protected by strict access controls and will not be commercialized or shared with unauthorized third parties.
Consent.section2Desc: MediTriage AI is a clinical decision-support and screening research prototype. It does NOT formulate definitive medical diagnoses, dispense prescriptions, or supersede the professional judgment of a registered medical practitioner. The attending clinician maintains absolute authority over all clinical decisions and patient routing.
Consent.section3Desc: If the patient is experiencing immediate life-threatening symptoms—including severe crushing chest pain, difficulty breathing, acute confusion/stroke signs, loss of consciousness, or massive bleeding—do NOT wait for online triage. Call Emergency Ambulance Services (112 / 108) or transport to the nearest Emergency Department immediately.
Consent.whoIsCompleting: Who is completing this intake and consent?
Consent.iamCaregiver: I am an Authorized Primary Caregiver / Family Member
Consent.dataConsentDesc: I explicitly consent to the collection and processing of the patient's medical history and symptoms strictly for triage prioritization in compliance with India's DPDP Act, 2023.
Consent.nonDiagnosticDesc: I understand that MediTriage AI provides decision support only and does not replace the diagnosis or treatment advice of a licensed physician.
Consent.emergencyProtocolDesc: I understand that severe, sudden-onset medical emergencies require immediate emergency dispatch (112 / 108) and hospital intervention.
